q: ARN (AMFI Registration Number) is required for:
o: Every MF distributor / firm to deal in mutual funds
e: ARN is mandatory for every MF distributor (firm or individual) wanting to deal in mutual funds. Issued by AMFI after passing the relevant NISM exam (V-A or V-B). Validity 3 years.

o: Employee Unique Identification Number — for the advising employee
e: EUIN is for the individual employee of an MFD/IFA who actually advises. ARN is for the firm/entity. Both must appear on the application form when advice is given.

q: Since 2018, mutual fund distributors are paid:
o: Trail commission only (with limited B-30 exceptions)
e: SEBI banned upfront commissions in 2018 (with limited exceptions for first-time B-30 city investors). Distributors now earn trail commissions only — annual % of AUM as long as the investor stays invested.

q: AMFI Code of Conduct prohibits which of the following?
e: Rebating — passing back any portion of commission to investors — is explicitly prohibited under AMFI Code of Conduct. Disclosure of commission is mandatory; KYC + complaint handling are standard duties.

q: The AMFI cap on gifts an AMC can give to a distributor is:
e: AMCs cannot give gifts above ₹500 in value to distributors. This prevents inducement that could bias scheme recommendations. Common trap question.

q: A 'Direct Plan' of a mutual fund scheme has:
o: Higher expense ratio than Regular Plan
e: Direct Plan has no distributor commission embedded → lower TER (typically 0.5-1.0% lower than Regular). Same portfolio + manager. Compounded over years, materially better net returns.

o: Each AMC requires its own KYC
One-time KYC valid across all SEBI intermediaries
e: CKYC = Central KYC. Once an investor completes CKYC with any one intermediary, the same KYC record is reused across all SEBI-registered intermediaries. No need to redo KYC at each AMC.

q: Which of these is NOT permitted in MF distributor advertisements?
o: Quoting CAGR for a scheme >3 years old
e: Promising guaranteed returns is strictly prohibited in MF advertising. Past performance + risk disclosures are mandatory; performance ads only for schemes >1 year old. CAGR mandatory for >3 yr.
